<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>A software application or tool that performs tasks, uses algorithms, and supports various formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Domain for most properties and central entity across CQs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?

    (competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>A software application or tool that performs tasks, uses algorithms, and supports various formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Domain for most properties and central entity across CQs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?
    (competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>A software application or tool that performs tasks, uses algorithms, and supports various formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Domain for most properties and central entity across CQs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?
    (competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?
    (competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?
    (competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational procedure or method used by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of uses property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>A change or alteration applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of modification property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Capability">
  <rdfs:comment>A function or feature provided by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Capability</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of provides property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareType">
  <rdfs:comment>The category or form factor of a software application.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Type</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of hasSoftwareType property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>An operation or job that software can perform or support.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of performs and supports properties</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DeploymentType">
  <rdfs:comment>The manner in which software is deployed or accessed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Deployment Type</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of isAvailableAs property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Information processed, created, or used by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of creates, worksWith, outputs, and uses properties</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format">
  <rdfs:comment>A specification for data structure or encoding.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of input/output format, reads, validInput, exportsTo, processes, dataExport properties</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific release or iteration of software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of version property, domain of feature and dataExport</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?
    (competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature">
  <rdfs:comment>A distinct capability added in a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Feature</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of feature property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>A resource providing assistance or guidance for using software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of helpResource property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer">
  <rdfs:comment>An entity responsible for creating or maintaining software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of developer property, domain of acceptsCollaboration</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Documentation">
  <rdfs:comment>Written or digital materials describing software usage.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Documentation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of documentation property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ73: Where is the documentation?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProgrammingLanguage">
  <rdfs:comment>A formal language used to write software code.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Programming Language</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of implementationLanguage property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Platform">
  <rdfs:comment>The computing environment or OS where software runs.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Platform</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of runsOn property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#License">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal permission governing software usage and distribution.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>License</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of license property, domain of permissiveness</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DevelopmentModel">
  <rdfs:comment>The methodology or community structure behind software development.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Development Model</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Range of developmentModel property</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

  <!-- owl:ObjectProperty declarations -->

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#uses">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to the algorithms or data it utilizes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Uses</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Algorithm and Data per CQ04, CQ16</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Algorithm -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#modification">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an algorithm to its modifications.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Algorithm to Modification per CQ05</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Algorithm -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Modification -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#provides">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to the capabilities it offers.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Provides</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Capability per CQ06</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Capability"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Capability -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#hasSoftwareType">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its type or form factor.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Software Type</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to SoftwareType per CQ07</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareType"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range SoftwareType -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#performs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to the tasks it executes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Performs</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Task per CQ08, CQ14</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Task -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#isAvailableAs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its deployment type.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Is Available As</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to DeploymentType per CQ11</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DeploymentType"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range DeploymentType -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#creates">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to the data it generates.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Creates</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Data per CQ15</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#supports">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to the tasks it enables.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Supports</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Task per CQ16</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Task -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#inputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its accepted input formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Format per CQ17</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#outputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its produced output formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Output Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Format per CQ17</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#reads">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to formats it can read.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Reads</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Format per CQ19</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#validInput">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its valid input formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Valid Input</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Format per CQ21</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#exportsTo">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to formats it can export to.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Exports To</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Format per CQ22</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#worksWith">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to data it can operate on.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Works With</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Data per CQ23</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#outputs">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to data it produces.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Outputs</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Data per CQ23</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Data -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#processes">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to formats it can process.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Processes</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Format per CQ26</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#dataExport">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a version to its data export formats.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Export</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Version to Format per CQ29</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Version -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Format -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#helpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its help resources.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to HelpResource per CQ32</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: range HelpResource -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#developer">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates software to its developer.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Connects Software to Developer per CQ36, CQ38</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Software -->
